key_insight: Sensitivity analysis helps anticipate which bubbly-liquid parameters a physics-informed neural network can recover from nonlinear waveforms.
engineering_relevance: The framework could guide parameter identification for ultrasound–microbubble models in biomedical and industrial applications.
method: Model weakly nonlinear wave propagation with a Korteweg–de Vries–Burgers equation.
Assess coefficient- and solution-level sensitivity to eight physical parameters.
Use a physics-informed neural network for forward prediction and single-parameter inverse estimation.
evidence_signal: The PINN reproduced a reference solution and estimated viscosity, initial bubble radius, density, sound speed, and pressure with 0.8–2.1% errors; the polytropic exponent converged partially, while surface tension could not be estimated.
watch_item: Results concern single-parameter estimation; joint recovery and robustness to noisy experimental waveforms are not established by the abstract.
paper_title: Sensitivity-Guided Parameter Estimation of Bubbly Liquid via a Nonlinear Wave Equation and Physics-InformedNeuralNetworks
